syllabus_extract: Role of guided missiles. Need for guidance in weapon. Classification of guided missiles
specific_objectives: 34.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain various terms on guided weapon.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list

practical: Review of guided missile diagrams and terminology from IB; Instructor supervision required for diagram interpretation.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a weapon guidance system?
Why are unguided weapons less effective against moving targets?
Can you list three types of guided missiles based on guidance method?

topics: Need for guidance in weapon systems
development.content:
Definition of guided missile
Need for guidance in weapon systems
Advantages over unguided weapons

Inertial guidance systems
Command guidance systems
Semi-active radar homing

Active radar homing
Optical and infrared guidance
Wire and laser guidance

summary_questions: Explain the difference between active and semi-active radar homing.
Describe the role of an inertial guidance unit in a missile.
Why is optical guidance preferred for certain target types?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note comparing the operational requirements of wire-guided versus radio-command guided missiles for the next lesson.
